title: S9-V0-R record bundle envelope (v3)
$comment: Self-contained ENVELOPE only. A bundle is a versioned collection of content-addressed records describing one dispatchable configuration. This schema checks the envelope shape and that every record is an object carrying a string kind + integer schema_version; the strict bundle validator (bundle_validate.py) then routes each record to its (kind, schema_version) schema, recomputes digests, checks cross-record links + dispatch tuples, and rejects unknown kinds/versions, duplicate JSON keys, missing records, and mismatched digests with stable error codes. bundle_version is const 2 so a v1 record set can never be reinterpreted under v2 rules.
